summary: Read a list of non-negative integers. A person stands on the leftmost cell. The number written in a cell is the largest forward distance that person may step from there, and any shorter step is also allowed. Decide whether the rightmost cell can be reached under those limits. Write yes when it can be reached, and write no when it cannot. Only that decision is required, not a count of steps.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
